portInfo.description: Ushuaia is the southernmost major cruise/Antarctic gateway in Argentina. The national ports agency describes a 550 m × 28 m multipurpose quay handling containers, fishing and passenger logistics, with more than 500 international cruise calls and about 250,000 seasonal visitors. Dirección Provincial de Puertos publishes operational cruise news for the commercial season. ANPyN records an administrative intervention of the port from 22 January 2026 — note for operators; passenger experience impact not verified.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.

thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Wind and sudden weather changes can cancel boats — keep a town backup plan.
